title: 别赌气
summary: He thinks she is sulking and tries again; she asks for the form instead.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands just inside the LEFT door of the office with the cardboard box on her hip; 张总 (S10) is in front of her mid-room; 钱经理 (S3) stands behind the desk where the printed resignation form lies face up; the office is bright and quiet.
[Shot 1] Medium: 张总 (S10) steps a half pace closer, drops his voice into something coaxing and unreasonable, and speaks in a soft hurried Mandarin, both hands up as if soothing a child: [Chinese] 苏小姐，您别赌气……
[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, close on 苏小满 (S1): she is not listening to the coaxing at all. She looks past him at the form on the desk and says it in her ordinary low Mandarin, as a request: [Chinese] 辞工单，给我。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.400, wide: 张总 (S10) stops mid-gesture; behind him 钱经理 (S3) flinches, and 张总 (S10) turns his head and glares at him.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on the form on the desk. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A soft coaxing voice, the cardboard box shifting, one flat request, then a chair scraping as the manager moves.

title: 字，我自己写的
summary: The manager carries the form over in both hands, and she signs it herself, on the last line.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands just inside the LEFT door with the box; 钱经理 (S3) is behind the desk with the printed resignation form in front of him; 张总 (S10) stands mid-room watching them both.
[Shot 1] Medium: 钱经理 (S3) stays on the far side behind the desk; he picks the form up and holds it out flat in both hands, level as a tray, across the desk toward her, and 苏小满 (S1) walks the two steps in from the doorway to the desk edge to take it.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, close two hands: 苏小满 (S1) takes the form, sets the cardboard box on the desk edge, and takes a ballpoint pen off the desktop.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, extreme close-up on the bottom of the form: her hand writing her own name in the final box in small, upright, very even characters.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.200, 苏小满 (S1) straightens, hands the form back to 钱经理 (S3) with both hands, and says it in her flat low Mandarin: [Chinese] 字，我自己写的。 Hold on the signed line as the beat ends.
soundscape: A form changing hands, a box set on a desk, a ballpoint scrawling on paper, then one flat sentence in a still room.

title: 多一分，我不要
summary: She picks the box up again, states her terms, and walks out of the office she has been sacked from.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands beside the desk with the signed form just handed back and her cardboard box on the desk edge; 钱经理 (S3) is behind the desk; 张总 (S10) is mid-room; the LEFT door stands open to the bright corridor.
[Shot 1] Close: 苏小满 (S1) turns back and looks at the cardboard box for a beat before she speaks, her hand resting on its open flap.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, she lifts the box to her chest, squares her shoulders and says it in her low even Mandarin, without bitterness or appeal: [Chinese] 工钱，该多少，是多少。多一分，我不要。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.600, she turns and walks out through the LEFT door into the corridor; 张总 (S10) opens his mouth to say something and does not manage it.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, hold on the open doorway behind her, the two men left standing in the office. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: One calm statement, her unhurried footsteps leaving over tile, the box brushing the doorframe, then the office behind her going quiet.
music: A warm low string line following her out of the room.

title: 一排黑车
summary: Silent beat: downstairs, brakes, a line of black cars at the kerb, doors opening all at once, and a file of suited men entering the building.
shots:
Entry state, new location, taken from the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) is inside the lift coming down with her cardboard box; 小罗 (S7) and a file of eight suited men are just getting out of the cars at the kerb outside and will come in across the ground-floor lobby from the glass doors on the LEFT of frame toward the lift bank; the reception counter is on the RIGHT; outside, the bright paved forecourt in front of 景宸大厦 with its row of black sedans along the kerb.
[Shot 1] Exterior wide: several cars pull up to the kerb in a line, one after another; brake lights bloom; the last one has barely stopped.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, all the doors open almost at the same instant; men in dark suits step out and close them in unison, then walk in a body toward the frosted-glass entrance doors.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.800, interior: they cross the lobby in step; 前台 (S12) behind the reception counter rises half out of her chair and stops talking mid-sentence; two people waiting by the lifts step back against the wall to clear the way.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, 苏小满 (S1) comes out of the lift into the lobby carrying her cardboard box, and the file of men is already coming straight at her along the lobby. Nobody speaks in this beat.
soundscape: Brake squeal and tyres on paving, multiple car doors opening and thudding shut, synchronized footsteps crossing a hard lobby floor, the lobby's background hush.
music: A low driving percussion figure, urgent and expensive.

title: 又见面了
summary: The leading man stops her in the middle of the lobby with a small bow and tells her the boss already knows everything.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) has just come out of the lift on the far side of the bright lobby carrying her cardboard box; 小罗 (S7) and the suited men are walking toward her along the lobby, the reception counter is on the RIGHT of frame, the glass wall on the LEFT.
[Shot 1] Medium: 小罗 (S7) stops dead one step in front of her; the men behind him stop in the same instant and close up one behind another in file at his back, stacked in depth.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.600, closer on 小罗 (S7) as he bends his head to her in a small courteous bow and speaks in his quiet unhurried Mandarin: [Chinese] 苏小姐。又见面了。
[Shot 3] At 00:05.600, he adds the second half in the same voice and at the same pace, evenly, watching her face: [Chinese] 今天的事，陆总都知道。
[Shot 4] At 00:09.200, wide of the lobby: everyone in it has stopped and turned to look — the receptionist behind the counter, passers-by, the security guard by the lifts. 苏小满 (S1) says nothing yet.
soundscape: Many leather soles stopping at once, a quiet courteous voice in a big stone lobby, then the whole lobby going still around them.
music: A low horn note under the bow.

title: 又是你们
summary: She recognises them, and the whole lobby is listening.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands in the middle of the bright lobby with the cardboard box against her chest; 小罗 (S7) faces her one step away with the line of suited men behind him; the crowd around the lobby has stopped to watch.
[Shot 1] Medium: 苏小满 (S1) looks 小罗 (S7) over once, from his collar to his shoes, with no surprise at all, and says it in her low flat Mandarin, half sigh and half statement: [Chinese] ……又是你们。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.600, tight on 小罗 (S7): he does not react to the tone at all; his face stays exactly as courteous as before.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, wide: every single head in the lobby is up. Someone at the lift bank whispers to someone else and is hushed.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, hold on her. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: One flat quiet line in a lobby where every conversation has stopped, a whisper travelling and dying, footsteps halted mid-step.

title: 请您走一趟
summary: He makes the invitation properly, in front of a lobby full of witnesses.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 小罗 (S7) stands one step in front of 苏小满 (S1) in the middle of the bright lobby; she holds the cardboard box; the suited men are in a line behind him; the lobby crowd is watching.
[Shot 1] Medium: 小罗 (S7) turns slightly so that he is speaking partly to the room, and delivers the invitation in the same quiet courteous Mandarin, gesturing once toward the glass doors and the street beyond:
[Shot 2] At 00:02.800, closer on his face: [Chinese] 陆家的车，在楼下。我们陆总，请您走一趟。
[Shot 3] At 00:09.200, cut wide to the lobby: nobody moves. Beyond the glass wall on the LEFT of frame the black sedans are standing at the kerb, visible from inside.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on 苏小满 (S1). Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: One quiet courteous invitation, then only the air handling, and the whole lobby holding still around them.

title: 昨天，今天
summary: She answers him with the two things they did to her, said flatly, in front of everyone.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) faces 小罗 (S7) in the middle of the bright lobby, the cardboard box in her arms; the line of suited men behind him; the watching crowd around the edges of frame.
[Shot 1] Close: 苏小满 (S1) looks straight at 小罗 (S7) and says the first one in her low flat Mandarin, stating it rather than accusing: [Chinese] 昨天，他们要搜我的兜。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, 苏小满 (S1) goes on in the same voice and at the same pace, without pausing, still perfectly level: [Chinese] 今天，他们要我签单走人。
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, tight on 小罗 (S7) listening to it without interrupting, without excusing it and without defending anyone.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: Two flat quiet statements in a still stone lobby, the air handling, one person in the crowd shifting their feet.

title: 单子，我自己写的
summary: She finishes the sentence, holds the box tighter and walks out; every door crack in the building has an eye in it.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands facing 小罗 (S7) in the middle of the bright lobby with the box against her chest; the glass entrance wall is on the LEFT of frame with the black cars beyond it.
[Shot 1] Close: 苏小满 (S1) finishes it in her low flat Mandarin, with one small nod as if confirming a fact to herself as much as to 小罗 (S7): [Chinese] 单子，我自己写的。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, she walks straight past him — he steps aside for her without being asked — and heads for the glass doors on the LEFT.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, out through the doors: the camera holds inside the lobby as she crosses the glass, and behind her the whole lobby is watching her go.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, pan along the interior windows and the corridor beyond: at every doorway and behind every strip of glass, faces are turned toward her. Nobody speaks in this beat.
soundscape: One flat sentence, her unhurried footsteps crossing a big stone floor and then polished paving outside, plus the hush of a lobby full of people saying nothing.
music: A warm low string line rising as she walks out.

title: 司机拉开了门
summary: Silent beat: the girl who lied to the manager keeps her head down, and out on the forecourt a driver opens the car door for her.
shots:
Entry state, taken from the reference images: outside, the bright paved forecourt with the row of black sedans along the kerb and the tower's entrance behind, 苏小满 (S1) already out on the paving a few paces clear of the doors with her cardboard box; the beat opens on one short cutaway back inside, then stays outside.
[Shot 1] Close, cutting back upstairs to the third floor: 小唐 (S4) is pressed into the office doorframe in the corridor, head buried, shoulders hunched, peering out past the jamb after her.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.800, outside on the forecourt: 苏小满 (S1) walks the last few paces further out into the open middle of the paving with the cardboard box in her arms; 小罗 (S7) comes out through the glass doors after her and stops half a step behind her LEFT shoulder, and she stops.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.400, a uniformed driver steps forward, opens the rear door of the nearest black sedan and stands holding it open, head bowed.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.600, close on her feet on the bright paving, not moving yet, the open car door reflected in the polished black flank of the car. Nobody speaks in this beat.
soundscape: A glass door sliding, a car door opening with a soft expensive clunk, the wind across an open forecourt, distant street traffic.
music: A quiet low piano figure, undecided.

title: 你们到底想干什么
summary: She stands at the open car door and asks the only question she actually cares about.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: outside on the bright forecourt, 苏小满 (S1) stands in front of the open rear door of a black sedan with the cardboard box in her arms; the driver holds the door; 小罗 (S7) has followed her out and stands half a step behind her LEFT shoulder; the row of black cars stretches along the kerb.
[Shot 1] Medium: 苏小满 (S1) does not get in. She turns her head toward 小罗 (S7) and asks it in her low even Mandarin, the first time she has asked them anything directly: [Chinese] 你们，到底想干什么。
[Shot 2] At 00:07.200, closer on 小罗 (S7), who has been waiting for exactly this question.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, hold on the two of them beside the open car door, the bright forecourt around them.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on her face. She is silent, waiting for the answer.
soundscape: An open forecourt with light wind, the tick of a cooling engine, one quiet direct question, the driver's shoes on paving.

title: 上车说
summary: He answers her in one long quiet sentence that puts her grandmother's ward number and the day of the black card into the same line.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the open rear door of the black sedan on the late-afternoon forecourt with the box in her arms; 小罗 (S7) is half a step behind her LEFT shoulder; the driver holds the door.
[Shot 1] Close on 小罗 (S7): he takes half a step closer and drops his voice so that only she can hear, speaking low and quickly in his courteous even Mandarin: [Chinese] 上车说。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, 小罗 (S7) goes on in the same voice and at the same pace, still pitched only for her: [Chinese] 您外婆在市一院，八楼。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.600, tight on 苏小满's (S1) eyes as the ward floor lands.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, hold on her face. She does not answer.
soundscape: A low voice pitched only for her, the forecourt ambience around them, the quiet interior of the car breathing its air conditioning out of the open door.
music: A low tense string note under the last clause.

title: 她上了车
summary: Silent beat: her eyes move, and she gets in.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the open rear door of the black sedan on the forecourt; 小罗 (S7) is half a step behind her LEFT shoulder; the car interior is visible through the open door — pale-grey leather bench, the amber roof lining lights switched off in the daylight.
[Shot 1] Extreme close-up on her eyes: something changes behind them — the same shut, deciding look she had in the office — and it takes less than a second.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, close on 小罗 (S7) as he finishes what he started, still quietly and only for her, in exactly the same voice and at the same pace as the line before: [Chinese] 陆总要谈的事，还是三天前那件。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, medium: she lifts the cardboard box and sets it in on the seat first, then ducks her head and gets in after it.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.400, the driver closes the rear door behind her with one soft push; 陆蔓 (S8), a composed woman of fifty in a deep-green jacquard silk qipao, is already seated on the LEFT rear seat with one empty place between them and looks out of the far window without turning her head; the car pulls away from the kerb into the late-afternoon light with its tail lights coming on; the next black car in the line moves up to take its place. Nobody else speaks in this beat.
soundscape: A light step onto the door sill, a soft expensive door closing, an engine starting and tyres rolling on paving, a control click somewhere inside the cabin.
music: The theme returns, low and driving, over the pull-away.

ref_notes.car_interior: the rear cabin of a black executive sedan, seen from the front seats looking back — a wide pale-grey leather rear bench, a central armrest, chrome door handles, amber courtesy lamps along the roof lining, tinted windows. Use as the location and prop reference only, NOT for lighting; the light through the open rear door is bright late-afternoon daylight. The car in it is empty.
